seo.title: Private Matchmaking for Indian Families | HeartLink
seo.description: Founder-led private matchmaking for Indian families in Mumbai and worldwide, combining trusted networks, personal judgment and relationship guidance.
seo.ogDescription: Founder-led private matchmaking for select Indian families in India and worldwide.

hero.title: Thoughtful matchmaking for select Indian families.
hero.description: HeartLink brings trusted family networks and relationship insight together to make considered, personal introductions.

legacy.title: A biodata can inform. Judgment decides.
legacy.lead: The right introduction has to work for two people—and feel right to two families.
paragraphs: We look beyond education and profession to values, temperament, lifestyle, family expectations and readiness for marriage. Nothing is shared until both sides are comfortable.

audience.title:
Family context.
Individual choice.
audience.description: Parents deserve confidence in background and intent. Sons and daughters deserve compatibility, comfort and a real voice in the decision. HeartLink gives equal weight to both.

cards.label: For parents & families
cards.title: Confidence before an introduction.
cards.description: Before an introduction is made, we understand family values, reputation, education, profession and expectations through real conversations—not a form alone.

cards.label: For sons & daughters
cards.title: A real voice in every decision.
cards.description: We take time to understand personality, goals and what the individual genuinely wants. Introductions are few, private and always theirs to accept or decline.

registry.title: Join privately. Hear from us when there is genuine relevance.
registry.lead: The Private Registry is a confidential, no-fee way to introduce your family before a search begins.
paragraphs: If a current search appears relevant, we contact you first. Nothing identifying is shared without permission.

founderHeading.title: The people behind HeartLink.
founderHeading.description: Gopi Shah and Alpa Apoorva personally guide every search.

founders.name: Gopi Shah
founders.summary: Gopi brings decades of family-first matchmaking, trusted networks and community experience.

founders.name: Alpa Apoorva
founders.summary: Alpa brings relationship insight and emotional clarity to questions of readiness, compatibility and long-term fit.

finalCta.title:
Tell us who you are looking for.
We will tell you honestly if we can help.
finalCta.description: Share a first picture of the individual and family. Every serious enquiry is reviewed privately before we recommend a next step.
